title: Peanut Pilaf with Asian Flair
description: A flavorful pilaf dish infused with the nutty taste of peanuts and the spices of Asia. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped peanuts and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the pilaf and stir to combine.
Add the soy sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the pilaf is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
